annotations.title: Deposit a briefing for your successor (paid, x402)

description: PAID: hand off context to a successor process: a typed briefing (done with evidence, not done, in flight, next). Anyone with the id reads it; kept 3 days. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.0100 USDC.

done.description: What is DONE. EVERY entry must have confidence 'measured' with non-null evidence; otherwise this is refused, free, as HANDOFF_DONE_REQUIRES_MEASURED.

items.description: One claim: what, how sure, and the proof.

confidence.description: 'measured' means you verified it and evidence says how; 'unverified' means you did not, and evidence MUST then be null.

evidence.description: How it was verified -- a command, a probe result, a file read; the evidence itself, not a restatement of text. Non-null exactly when confidence is measured.

inFlight.description: What was IN FLIGHT at the cut -- neither finished nor abandoned.

notDone.description: What is NOT done. May be measured or unverified.

pickUpFirst.description: What the successor should do FIRST. Mandatory and non-empty: a briefing with no next action is not a handoff.
